type_system.note: These analysis types describe candidate contracts only. They do not replace or amend the unavailable local IR v0.2 definition.

types.name: String
types.description: Text usable as a query or answer.

types.name: ValueSet
types.description: Zero or more scalar semantic values.

types.name: ComparisonResult
types.description: An ordering, relation, or selected-key result.

operators.name: TABLE_LOOKUP
operators.purpose: Resolve a structured-table subquestion in one coarse step.
operators.semantics: Select relevant rows and fields, optionally deduplicate, and return table-derived values or rows.

output_ports.name: result
output_ports.description: Rows or values satisfying the lookup.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: The union output hides whether rows or values are returned.

executability.rationale: A table engine can bind the macro.

composability.rationale: Macro outputs compose, but internal dependencies are opaque.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Filtering, projection, and selection may be fused.

known_risks: May mask dead or unnecessary internal work

operators.name: DOCUMENT_QA
operators.purpose: Answer an attribute subquestion from linked or retrieved documents in one step.
operators.semantics: Locate document evidence, select text, extract an answer, and optionally parse it.

input_ports.name: subjects
input_ports.description: Entities or query text that scope document answering.

reusability.rationale: Generic document question answering recurs across schemas.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Declared value type helps, but evidence selection is hidden.

executability.rationale: Execution depends on retriever and reader contracts.

composability.rationale: Values compose but document provenance may be lost.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Retrieval, extraction, parsing, and normalization are fused.

known_risks: May behave like an unconstrained reader

operators.name: COMPARE
operators.purpose: Compare candidate values and optionally identify matching candidates.
operators.semantics: Apply a declared relation or ordering to values, including tie behavior.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: The result union merges relation testing and arg-selection.

composability.rationale: Comparison results feed selection or answer mapping.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Comparison and arg-selection may be fused.

known_risks: Can hide parse and normalization prerequisites

operators.name: CALCULATE
operators.purpose: Perform arithmetic or aggregation in one coarse operation.
operators.semantics: Apply a declared aggregate or arithmetic expression to one or more values.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Aggregation and arithmetic share a broad contract.

executability.rationale: Declared numeric functions can be deterministic.

composability.rationale: Scalar results are easy to compose.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Multiple operations and normalization may be hidden.

known_risks: Obscures whether aggregation or arithmetic is required

rejected_patterns.reason: Encodes a question-specific relation rather than a reusable operation.
Bundles an entire surface template into a pseudo-primitive.

exception_requirements: Demonstrate reuse across multiple questions and schemas
Record pilot evidence and reviewer agreement

known_global_risks: Reasoning is hidden inside macro operators
Exact topology comparisons become less informative
